reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names the Director General of Customs, this is in an official regulatory capacity rather than a personnel appointment, and no detailed portfolio responsibilities are described. The content focuses on legal implementation of exchange rates rather than government structure or personnel changes.
